_comment: The themes a reader can pick from the header. RiskMandate is the default and the first; Canvas is its dark variant; Night, Ember, Paper and Blueprint are the newsroom.sgit.ai themes (assets/themes/themes.css there, v0.12.12, 13 October 2026) mapped onto this site's tokens. Every colour on the site is a token, and assets/themes.css gives every token a value in every theme, in a block :root[data-theme=<id>]. assets/theme.js sets the attribute before the first paint, from localStorage (the key below) or, when nothing is stored, from the reader's prefers-color-scheme. The picker is generated from this file by admin/build/chrome.py. tests/build/test_themes.py checks that this file, theme.js and themes.css name the same themes, that every theme defines every token, that no colour is written anywhere else, and that the pairs a reader reads hold their contrast.

themes.name: Canvas
themes.from: riskmandate.ai's dark hero, as a whole page
